comparison.objective: Tamp coffee level and twist-lock a portafilter into a group head; candidate unlocks, adjusts, and relocks a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Both require bimanual stabilization, axial alignment, rotation, and locking, but portafilter work tests tamping and bayonet insertion; candidate tests recessed hex-key use, fine calibration, torque control, and response-based iteration.
comparison.success_condition: Portafilter success requires a level tamp and locked pose within stated alignment and angle tolerances; candidate requires two quantified impact cycles and a witness-torque drift test.
comparison.reason: This has manipulation-level similarities, but it does not test adjustable mechanism commissioning or dynamic-response calibration.
